name: Pendry Park City
insider_take: This ski-in, ski-out luxury haven sits at the base of Park City Mountain Resort, where Olympic dreams were made and powder days are perfected.
whats_special: Pendry Park City occupies prime real estate in Canyons Village, offering direct access to over 7,300 acres of skiable terrain. The hotel features Utah's largest rooftop pool and hot tub, plus the acclaimed Kembara restaurant serving Southeast Asian cuisine at 7,000 feet elevation. Its location puts you steps from the gondola that connects to the 2002 Winter Olympics venues.
pro_tip: Book a mountain-view suite during Sundance Film Festival season (January) - you'll catch glimpses of celebrity guests while enjoying exclusive access to private events and film screenings.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature après-ski scene at Montage Deer Valley's neighboring slopes, plus easy access to Park City's historic Main Street via the complimentary shuttle. In summer, the location transforms into a mountain biking paradise with lift-accessed trails and the famous Alpine Slide just minutes away.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location at Canyons Village
Luxury mountain resort with sophisticated design
Multiple dining venues and rooftop experiences
cons: Premium pricing during peak ski season
Limited availability due to high demand
